name: camino
description: Plataforma operativa de Camino Col (PWA + Supabase)

scripts.setup: docker compose run --rm dev npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.build: docker compose run --rm dev npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm dev npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: docker compose run --rm dev npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: docker compose run --rm dev npm --prefix apps/web run lint
